# Agency Upscale

> Agency Upscale is an all-in-one SaaS CRM, digital marketing agency management software, and business operating system built for digital marketing agencies, sales teams, and growing small businesses in India and worldwide.

## Product Overview
- **Product Name**: Agency Upscale
- **Category**: Digital Marketing CRM, Agency Management Software, SaaS CRM, Client Management System
- **Target Audience**: Digital marketing agencies, creative studios, performance marketing teams, sales teams, and small-to-mid-sized businesses (India and global markets)
- **Pricing Model**: Flat workspace pricing (no per-user seat tax) — Free Forever (100 MB, up to 3 clients), Starter at ₹10/month (5 GB), Growth at ₹2,999/month (25 GB), and Enterprise Pro at ₹6,999/month (100 GB)

## Verified Capabilities
- **CRM & Lead Management**: Pipeline stages, lead scoring, follow-up reminders, call history, and 1-click conversion from lead to client.
- **Clients 360 & Client Portal**: Centralized client directory, credential vault, and branded client portal for approvals, tasks, and invoices.
- **Projects & Task Management**: Kanban boards, task timers, EOD checklists, sprint/development boards, and team workload views.
- **Social Media & Content Calendar**: 31-day monthly post/reel tracker, ad campaign budget tracking, and client approval workflows.
- **Finance & GST Invoicing**: Quotations, GST invoices, payment tracking, expense logs, payroll, and branch-level reporting.
- **HR & Attendance**: Team directory, GPS-verified clock-in/out, WFH requests, and multi-branch management.
- **Proposals & SOP Library**: Interactive client proposals and team standard operating procedures.
